description:
Make a new agent definition by copying a template, or check a definition folder. One op per call:
- copy a stock template: {"op": "new", "template": "agent-fsm", "path": "defs/helper"}  (templates: agent-fsm, eca-claude; path must not exist yet; relative paths start at your workspace)
- copy any other definition folder: {"op": "new", "from": "defs/helper", "path": "defs/helper2"}
- check: {"op": "check", "path": "defs/helper"}  (prints {"problems": [...]}; empty list = OK)
new only copies. Then edit the copy with your normal file tools (system.txt, tools.json, llm.json). To run it: agents_children {"op": "add", "def": "defs/helper", "name": "kid"}.
Errors: ArgumentsBad, OpUnknown, DefMissing, DefExists (pick another path), DefBad, DirectiveBad. Details: knowledge_read aos/agents.json#/agent_def.

op.description: new = copy a template to a new definition folder, check = check a definition folder

template.description: new: the name of a stock template to copy: agent-fsm or eca-claude

from.description: new, instead of template: any definition folder to copy (relative to your workspace, or absolute; a directive object also works)

path.description: new: the new definition folder (must not exist yet). check: the definition folder. Relative to your workspace, or absolute
